newsitem.title: USA: Terex sale agreement for clark material ends.
newsitem.headline: Terex sale agreement for clark material ends.

text.p: Terex Corp said Wednesday the agreement recently signed for the sale of its Clark Material Handling Co to Clark Acquisition Corp, a company formed by Nesco Inc, has been terminated.
Nesco is a privately-held, diversified, multi-national industrial manufacturing and engineering service corporation headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio.
Terex issued a statement saying it is disappointed that the agreement had been terminated after the parties were unable to resolve a contractual dispute, the statement said.
